title: [review] lichen-oscore: provisioning.rs orphaned (not declared in lib.rs), subtle dep dead
description: P2 (pre-existing, surfaced by wave-1 review). rust/lichen-oscore/src/provisioning.rs (~900 lines, uses subtle/sha2/HKDF) is NOT declared in lib.rs -> silently not compiled; subtle is an unused dependency in every configuration. Decide: declare the module (if provisioning API is wanted) or delete the file + dep. Note lichen-node has its own provisioning module (separate). Do not silently re-enable: check whether the API matches the current oscore crate version before declaring.
